text:
You need a reliable, organized virtual assistant who can move quickly, follow structure, and handle repetitive admin tasks with care while learning your workflow.

I’m Noor Halden, and I bring 6 years of experience in Python, machine learning, NLP, scikit-learn, PyTorch, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, XGBoost, and pandas. While my background is technical, the work I’ve done has required exactly the kind of precision, consistency, and deadline focus you’re looking for: clean execution, attention to detail, and the ability to learn a process fast and apply it reliably.

In a recent project, I built a WhatsApp and SMS assistant for Parcelwise Logistics that tracked parcels, rescheduled deliveries, and handed off to a human with full context. It resolved 43% of conversations without an agent and reached a CSAT of 4.4 out of 5. That work strengthened my ability to follow structured workflows, manage information accurately, and keep communication organized.

I also worked on telecom churn prediction, where I built a monthly churn score for 380k subscribers with per-customer SHAP reasons the retention team could read. That model reached an AUC of 0.84 on a held-out quarter and a top-decile lift of 3.1x. From that project, I learned how important clear outputs, careful data handling, and dependable execution are when the details matter.

For your role, I would be comfortable with copy-pasting precise questionnaire information, entering customer data into your management system, following your training to create slideshows, and doing selective photo sorting based on your criteria. I’m also comfortable with structured communication and can read and write professional English clearly. If French is needed, I’m open to working within that process and learning your preferred style.

I understand you want someone who is hard-working, loyal, on time, and organized. That is exactly the kind of role I’m looking to do well in. If we work together, you can expect me to stay consistent, learn quickly, and protect your deadlines and workflow as carefully as I would my own.

And for the story about laughing to tears: one time I laughed so hard at a completely wrong autocorrect message that I had to stop typing because I couldn’t see the screen properly.
